name: green-process-fact-contract-experience-layer-commands
title: Green the RED process-fact-contract: register playbook_*/signature_registry_*/recall + reconcile DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS
description: A framework health re-audit found that `npm run test:process-fact-contract` is currently RED on main (verified by running it). The Experience Layer + related stories (B-8387 playbook_*, B-4f46 signature_registry_*, and a `recall` command) added commands to the MAIN_TOOLS registry in cli-engine.ts but never registered them in PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY (packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts, the inventory that proves each flow-fact command has a hardcoded fallback owner), and the DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS phase allowlists drifted. The guard reports: MAIN_TOOLS commands missing from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY = playbook_approve, playbook_diff, playbook_propose, playbook_reject, recall, signature_registry_list, signature_registry_set; plus DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS phase allowlist drift for patterns recall / signature_registry_* / playbook_* across PLAN/REVIEW/TEST. This is a live broken process-fact invariant. It went undetected because the contract guard (scripts/verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs via test:process-fact-contract / verify-*.mjs family) is NOT wired into the gate-consumed battery (that decoupling is a separate story, B-99b6). Outcome: register every missing command in PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY with an accurate level/category/owner/rationale (mirror the existing entries in process-fact-registry.ts ~line 871+ and the format in process-fact-levels.ts; classify each per what it actually does — e.g. signature_registry_list/playbook_diff are read-only L0/L1, playbook_approve/reject and signature_registry_set are mutating), and reconcile DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS (config.ts) so the recall/signature_registry_*/playbook_* phase allowlists no longer drift from the registry/command-policy. After the fix, `npm run test:process-fact-contract` MUST exit 0 (green) — the gate does not run it today, so verify it EXPLICITLY by running the script, do not rely on `lattice validate`. Scope: process-fact-registry.ts registrations + config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS reconciliation only; do NOT change the commands' behavior, do NOT wire the guard into the battery (that is B-99b6), do NOT touch the gitRoot work (separate story).
